sideEffects.description: Angular 22.1.1 / TS 6.0.3 / Node 24 audited. Repo already had parallel contracts in features/adverts/domain/ + shared/. Per explicit user instruction, Phase 0 core/contracts/ layer WAS created as canonical, coexisting with existing types.
sideEffects.resolution: handled — new generic contracts created under src/app/core/contracts/; merging/unifying with the pre-existing features/adverts/domain/ + shared/ contracts is DEFERRED to a later integration phase. Dual-source-of-truth risk logged.

sideEffects.description: Phase 4 verification: repo tsc (npx tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit) exit 0; repo lint (ng lint) 'All files pass linting'. Both PROPOSED CONTRACT comments present on repository interfaces. Domain-agnostic self-check passed (no Real Estate fields).

Phase 5 discovery: a complete, mature Dynamic Form Engine already exists in shared/form/ + shared/category/ (Signal Forms via @angular/forms/signals), covering every Phase 5 requirement: field-type->component registry, signal form state, section/field renderers, visibility conditions, validation registry, read-only presenter (advert-attributes.presenter), serializer.
sideEffects.resolution: handled — REUSED, not rebuilt. No parallel engine created on core/contracts FieldDefinition (that contract remains unintegrated). Verified health: tsc exit 0, ng lint pass, ng test 19 files/97 tests green, field components SSR-safe (no browser globals).
